title: The category structure induced on the filtered object colimit
statement: For a small filtered category J and a functor F : J → Cat of small categories, let O be the colimit of its object sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. There exist a category structure on O and functors V_j : F(j) → O whose object maps are the object coprojections and which commute strictly with every transition functor. There is a colimit cocone of the sets of arrows [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] equipped with an equivalence to Arrow O intertwining its coprojections with the arrow maps of V_j.

source.place: proof of Lemma Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), first paragraph: 'The formula C = colim C_i means that Ob(C) = colim Ob(C_i) and Arrows(C) = colim Arrows(C_i). Then source, target, and composition are inherited ... Remark that given any finite diagram in C there exists an i such that this diagram is the image of a diagram in C_i' (stated without proof); filtered colimits of sets: categories.tex Section Tag 04AX

proof.text: Use the descended endpoint maps and their Hom fibers. Obtain identity and composition from the fiber-operations theorem and their category axioms from the fiber-laws theorem. Assemble the category instance with Hom equal to these fibers. Define each stage functor by object and arrow coprojections; the preservation formulas prove its functor laws.

Prove strict compatibility using Functor.ext, the object cocone equation, and the arrow cocone equation. Equality of underlying fiber elements yields equality of entire arrows including endpoints; Arrow.mk_eq_mk_iff gives the transported map equality.

Take the canonical set colimit cocone of arrows. Map an element to the arrow in its endpoint fiber and map a categorical arrow back to its underlying fiber element. Prove both inverse identities by subtype extensionality and equality of entire arrows. The canonical cocone is colimiting and its equivalence intertwines the stage arrow maps.

lean.statement: theorem filteredColimit_category_structure (J : Type z) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{z, z}) : let O := colimit (F ⋙ Cat.objects) ∃ (s : Category.{z} O), letI := s ∃ V : ∀ j : J, F.obj j ⥤ O, (∀ (j : J) (X : F.obj j), (V j).obj X = colimit.ι (F ⋙ Cat.objects) j X) ∧ (∀ (j k : J) (f : j ⟶ k), (F.map f).toFunctor ⋙ V k = V j) ∧ (∃ (a : Cocone (F ⋙ Cat.arrows)) (e : a.pt ≃ Arrow O), Nonempty (IsColimit a) ∧ ∀ (j : J) (f : Arrow (F.obj j)), e (a.ι.app j f) = (V j).mapArrow.obj f)
